chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"The place of the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, from the day he was buried in it, is a garden from the gardens of Paradise."

key_terms.رَوْضَةٌ: a garden or meadow of delight
key_terms.مَوْضِعُ: the place or site being described
key_terms.مُنْذُ: since, indicating continuity from a point in time

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the site of the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام has, since his burial, possessed a sanctified reality linked to Paradise. It expresses the exalted rank of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and the spiritual distinction of his burial place.
